subject: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:14:00Z
Subject: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. To get the invoice flow nailed down for your go-live, we need to confirm two decisions from BrightWorks: the invoice delivery channel (email PDF vs. portal/SFTP/API push) and who will be the authoritative billing contact for PO/collection.

Quick proposal from our side:
- Default delivery: Redwood portal webhooks (preferred for automation) with monthly PDF copy emailed to ap@brightworks.com.
- Fallback: If you need a push-based file, we can support SFTP or secure email (TLS) for the first 60 days while your AP team provisions portal access.
- VAT: We received your VAT certificate during onboarding; please re-send the certified copy to ap@brightworks.com if anything changed.

Action items for BrightWorks: please confirm 1) delivery preference (Portal vs SFTP vs Email-only) 2) billing contact (name, role, email) 3) whether you require invoice XML/EDIFACT/Peppol schema or a PDF is enough for now.

Attached: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (shows header, tax breakdown, invoice_id example).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m screen share to walk through integration.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (PDF - 48KB)

From: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@brightworks.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@brightworks.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightworks.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear options. A couple of notes from AP:

- Preferred delivery: We want invoices pushed to our SFTP collector for ingestion into our ERP (Coupa). However, as discussed, we still need a monthly PDF copy emailed to ap@brightworks.com for manual review during the first month.
- Billing contact: Liam O'Connor, Head of Finance Operations (liam.oconnor@brightworks.com). CC'ing him.
- VAT: I've attached a copy of our VAT cert for your records.
- Schema: For now, PDF + SFTP transmission is fine. We'll revisit XML/Peppol later.

One ask: can Redwood set the invoice sender to be BrightWorks bill-to entity (i.e., include our remit-to/reference fields) so our AP auto-matching works? If that requires a contract amendment or explicit authorization, flag it and we'll coordinate legal.

Appreciate it — Oliver

Attachment: brightworks-vat-cert.pdf (PDF - 120KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@brightworks.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths

On 2027-05-29 11:03, Oliver Shaw wrote:
> Hi Priya —
>
> Thanks for the clear options. A couple of notes from AP:
>
> - Preferred delivery: We want invoices pushed to our SFTP collector for ingestion into our ERP (Coupa). However, as discussed, we still need a monthly PDF copy emailed to ap@brightworks.com for manual review during the first month.
> - Billing contact: Liam O'Connor, Head of Finance Operations (liam.oconnor@brightworks.com). CC'ing him.
> - VAT: I've attached a copy of our VAT cert for your records.
> - Schema: For now, PDF + SFTP transmission is fine. We'll revisit XML/Peppol later.

Thanks — that's clear and workable. A couple of operational clarifications from our side:

1) Sender name / remit fields: We can populate the invoice 'Bill To' and 'Remit To' fields with BrightWorks details to help your matching logic. That does not require a contract amendment, but we do need signed authorization that allows Redwood to include BrightWorks as the invoice originator in metadata. We can collect that via a short authorization form (I can share a template).

2) SFTP details: can your team share the hostname, path, and a test account (or a public key) to set up pushes? If you prefer, we can initiate an SFTP drop and simultaneously deliver a portal webhook so you can validate both flows.

3) PO numbers: we'll include a PO reference field in the invoice-summary by default; confirm whether you expect PO on the invoice number line or as a separate field for Coupa.

Next steps:
- Oliver: send SFTP connection (host/path/key) or confirm you want API/webhook.
- Liam: if you can reply with the signed authorization (template attached in a follow-up) we can set the 'invoice sender' metadata accordingly.

Looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Ben (payments) to own the setup.

Best,
Priya

---
Priya Natarajan
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightworks.com>, Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@brightworks.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths — SFTP/Payment collection

Morning Liam / Oliver —

Thanks for confirming SFTP + PDF copy. Two short items from Billing & Payments:

• File format: We will send a compressed batch file nightly (CSV envelope + PDFs). Please confirm Coupa wants a CSV line-per-invoice or a single manifest file.
• Collection: Redwood supports both ACH (US) and SEPA (EU) collections. For BrightWorks we assume SEPA direct debit is preferred once invoices are posted; until then, please confirm whether you'll pay via supplier portal or send remittance by email.

If you're likely to use SEPA, Ben can share our collection instruction template and cutoff dates. If AP prefers to push payment manually, note that early payment discounts/Net terms are unchanged.

Also: we'll configure the first 2 invoice cycles as 'email copy + SFTP' and then switch to portal/webhook only once your connector tests cleanly. We'll send a test file on Friday 2027-06-04 unless you want an earlier dry run.

Ben — please track follow-up and provide the collection instruction template.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-05-30T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice ownership transfer and delivery paths — confirmation

Thanks all — quick confirmations:

- We'll provide SFTP creds (host and a deploy key) by COB Wednesday 2027-06-02.
- BrightWorks signs the authorization (scanned copy to follow).
- Coupa requires a CSV manifest with one row per invoice; please include invoice_id, invoice_date, amount_net, VAT_amount, PO_number, remit_reference. PDFs can be zipped alongside with matching filenames.
- For payment: we'll start with manual payments via our portal for the first 60 days, then enable SEPA once the connector is stable.

Appreciate the clear plan. Sending the VAT cert and authorization in separate emails shortly.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations | BrightWorks Ltd
